-- intro: Demon Fire Magic is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate a sinister form of Fire Magic.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate a sinister form of fire at will. The flames are capable of burning anything and everything, including shadows, light, and even invisible concepts. The user is able to use this magic without the need of a grimoire. Superior overall to its regular Fire Magic counterpart, this fire is extremely deadly and versatile, from shooting a barrage of flame bullets, releasing waves of blazing fire, creating a twister that incinerates anything in its path, and a plethora of other phenomenally powerful fire techniques. Furthermore, the user can use this magic to turn their body, either partly or fully, into fire or even merge with and move through it.
